t: Will the facade be damaged during cleaning?
d: No. We work with low water pressure. The cleaning agent loosens algae, mould and fungi, and we then rinse them off with clear water. The render stays undamaged.

t: Does scaffolding have to be put up?
d: No. Our technicians work from the ground with telescopic lances up to 12 metres long. For taller buildings we use an aerial work platform. There are no scaffolding costs.

t: How do you clean facades that are taller than 12 metres?
d: Up to around 12 metres our technicians work from the ground with telescopic lances. We clean taller facades from an aerial work platform. No scaffolding is put up.

t: Can I clean the facade myself with a pressure washer?
d: We advise against it. High water pressure can damage the render. That is why our process uses low pressure, and the long-term protection delays regrowth.

t: How does the test patch work?
d: You request the test patch via the form or by phone. We clean a section of your facade. You see the result on your own building and then decide whether we should clean the whole facade.

t: What does the cleaning cost?
d: Facade cleaning costs up to 70% less than repainting. We will tell you the price for your building in a free quote.

t: What does the test patch cost?
d: Nothing. The test patch is free and you can request it at any time. We do not charge for the quote or for travel either.

t: Why not simply repaint?
d: Because cleaning is up to 70% cheaper and postpones repainting by many years. It is also more environmentally friendly than a complete repaint. In addition, painters do not usually give a guarantee against new algae growth when they repaint.

t: How long does the facade stay clean?
d: After cleaning we apply a transparent long-term protection. It delays regrowth for up to 5 years. The protection can be reapplied at any time.

t: What do you remove from the facade?
d: Algae, mould, fungal growth, moss, lichen, fine dust, road dust, soot and grease.

t: Can the long-term protection be renewed?
d: Yes. The facade protection can be reapplied at any time.

t: Which buildings is the cleaning suitable for?
d: We clean single-family homes, apartment buildings, residential complexes, company buildings, care homes and prefab panel blocks.

t: Where does FassadenTrio work?
d: Our base is in Südlohn in the Münsterland region. We work throughout Germany and all over Europe.

t: Do you also clean the windows?
d: Yes, on request. We offer window cleaning following the facade cleaning.
